Bub. p. 110 שמרבבת) that is the south wind which overweaves (which lines) the sky as with a thick lining; Yalk. ib. 942.—2) pl. רְבִיבִים (b. h.; רָבַב, cmp. רְבִיעָה) [growth-advancing,] rains. Sifré l. c. (ref. to Deut. l. c.) מה ר׳ הללו יורדים וכ׳ as the rains come down on plants &c.; Yalk. l. c.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 25a:14">B. Bath. 25ᵃ</cite> (ref. to Deut. l. c.) <he>זו רוח … ר׳ וכ׳</he> that is the south wind which brings rains and makes the plants grow; ib.ᵇ; a. e.
